base_note: Local commit of patch 0018; GitLab main d241fe4 (merge request !43) has the same tree. fixes/apply.py checks the commit, so apply on d64465d or use git apply on a clean d241fe4 checkout.
relationship_to_prior_patch: Incremental on patch 0018 (GitLab main d241fe4). Do not reapply earlier patches.

save_format.note: No saved state changes; saves move freely between this DLL and the 0018 DLL.

fixes.retrain_disband: CvPlayerAI::AI_doTurnUnitsPost disbanded city units for a retrained unit exactly when enemies stood within two plots (BBAI port inverted the BTS check); now only when the city is safe.
fixes.lead_from_behind: CvUnitAI::LFBgetBetterAttacker scaled the whole rank, including its +10000 offset, by collateral, so any collateral unit outranked every other attacker; now it scales the odds part only, and only for collateral that does damage.
fixes.assault_opener: pickCollateralAttacker (CvSelectionGroup.cpp) ranks units by effective collateral strength, base strength x collateral % / 100 as an integer, and skips units below 2.

switches: None. The fixes act at every AI_CUNNING_FLAGS value; at 0 the AI is the 0017 AI with these three fixes.

measured.equivalence: With AI_CUNNING_FLAGS 111 this tree replays, turn for turn, the earlier experimental arm 4207 (111 + a switch 4096 that gated exactly these three changes): identical game state over Mediterranean and Earth 12 Marathon games, seeds 1 and 2.

oracle_8_games.games: Mediterranean and Earth 12, Marathon, Noble, seeds 1-4, turns 0-450, against the shipped 0018 (111)
oracle_8_games.clear_attacker_mistakes: unchanged; they come from sacrifices of spearmen and hypaspists, not the attacker choice
